shortDescription: Configuration for ns log action resource.

options.name: acl
options.description: Log access control list (ACL) messages.

options.name: alg
options.description: Log the ALG messages

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: appflowexport
options.description: Export log messages to AppFlow collectors. Appflow collectors are entities to which log messages can be sent so that some action can be performed on them.

options.name: contentinspectionlog
options.description: Log Content Inspection event information

options.name: dateformat
options.description: Format of dates in the logs. Supported formats are: * C(MMDDYYYY) - U.S. style month/date/year format. * C(DDMMYYYY) - European style date/month/year format. * C(YYYYMMDD) - ISO style year/month/date format.

options.name: domainresolvenow
options.description: Immediately send a DNS query to resolve the server's domain name.

options.name: domainresolveretry
options.description: Time, in seconds, for which the Citrix ADC waits before sending another DNS query to resolve the host name of the audit server if the last query failed.

options.name: logfacility
options.description: Facility value, as defined in RFC 3164, assigned to the log message. Log facility values are numbers 0 to 7 (C(LOCAL0) through C(LOCAL7)). Each number indicates where a specific message originated from, such as the Citrix ADC itself, the VPN, or external.

options.name: loglevel
options.description: Audit log level, which specifies the types of events to log. Available settings function as follows: * C(ALL) - All events. * C(EMERGENCY) - Events that indicate an immediate crisis on the server. * C(ALERT) - Events that might require action. * C(CRITICAL) - Events that indicate an imminent server crisis. * C(ERROR) - Events that indicate some type of error. * C(WARNING) - Events that require action in the near future. * C(NOTICE) - Events that the administrator should know about. * C(INFORMATI

options.name: lsn
options.description: Log the LSN messages

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the nslog action. Must begin with a letter, number, or the underscore character (_), and must contain only letters, numbers, and the hyphen (-), period (.) pound (#), space ( ), at (@), equals (=), colon (:), and underscore characters. Cannot be changed after the nslog action is added.  The following requirement applies only to the Citrix ADC CLI: If the name includes one or more spaces, enclose the name in double or single quotation marks (for example, "my nslog action" or 'my nslog act

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: protocolviolations
options.description: Log protocol violations

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: serverdomainname
options.description: Auditserver name as a FQDN. Mutually exclusive with serverIP

options.name: serverip
options.description: IP address of the nslog server.

options.name: serverport
options.description: Port on which the nslog server accepts connections.

options.name: sslinterception
options.description: Log SSL Interception event information

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(absent), the resource will be deleted from the NetScaler ADC node. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: subscriberlog
options.description: Log subscriber session event information

options.name: tcp
options.description: Log TCP messages.

options.name: timezone
options.description: Time zone used for date and timestamps in the logs. Available settings function as follows: * C(GMT_TIME). Coordinated Universal Time. * C(LOCAL_TIME). The server's timezone setting.

options.name: trafficplane
options.description: Traffic Plane to which the logs will be sent.

options.name: urlfiltering
options.description: Log URL filtering event information

options.name: userdefinedauditlog
options.description: Log user-configurable log messages to nslog. Setting this parameter to C(NO) causes auditing to ignore all user-configured message actions. Setting this parameter to C(YES) causes auditing to log user-configured message actions that meet the other logging criteria.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
